description.shortText: Life event—based services go further than a single agency focusing on improving the customer interaction. Instead, they represent a realignment and integration of information and resources by understanding and anticipating the cluster of needs a citizen may have. Therefore, life event approach can significantly improve customer experience by offering the appropriate “basket” of services. The cluster of services include marriage, New Business, Employment, Child Birth and so on.
